name: Stormbringer: Cyclone's Recharge shortens Kiss of the Clouds on Shock, Gale and Electrocute (#1771)
contract: Cyclone's Recharge 300827 (Spell.dbc: passive Attributes 448, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA / aura 42
PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 300828, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) promises "Casting Shock, Gale or
Electrocute now reduces the remaining cooldown of your Kiss of the Clouds by $/1000;300828s1 sec".
300828 has one SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with EffectBasePoints -1001 + EffectDieSides 1 =
-1000 ms and EffectMiscValue 500039 Kiss of the Clouds. 300827's DBC ProcFlags are 0, so
SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp: "if (!spellInfo->ProcFlags) continue;") and no
spell_proc row existed, leaving the aura with no entry in mSpellProcMap: it can never fire. Even once it
fires, Player::ModifySpellCooldown keys the cooldown map by the exact EffectMiscValue id, so the named
rank 1 (500039) is not the rank a level-80 player casts: Kiss of the Clouds is a 9-rank chain
(spell_ranks first_spell_id 500039, rank 9 = 501449) with Category 56 and CategoryRecoveryTime 30000,
and the category stores an entry for every rank. The three sources are identified by SpellFamilyName 22
masks over the 953 family-22 spells: Shock 0x800 (9 ranks), Gale 0x4000 (5 ranks), Electrocute 0x2000000
(13 ranks). An identical unarmed control player casts the same spells in lockstep so ordinary cooldown
decay cancels out. Call Lightning (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10, outside all three masks) is the off-family
negative control. Both targets use Harvest Golem 36. Rabbit 721 runs native CritterAI and flees on
combat engagement, invalidating repeated facing-sensitive casts in a cooldown fixture; the related
Titanstorm scenario recorded UNIT_NOT_INFRONT. Each normal source cast must be accepted and complete
before comparing the original rank cooldown limits. Refill the original Static aura before Call
Lightning, require real direct damage, and verify no further cooldown reduction. All three ranks of
Electrocute checked in this batch (501421, 501432, 801844) carry Spell.dbc TargetAuraState 13
(AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT), so it only lands on a target already below 35% health; the fixture
drops both dummies to 30% before the Electrocute casts so the spell is not rejected with
SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE before the on-cast proc phase ever runs.
DISCRIMINATING: the rank 1 entry named by EffectMiscValue also loses 1000 ms, proving the proc fired at
all
30% health: Electrocute's TargetAuraState 13 (AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT) needs the target below
